text:
Noor: Tiny triple-win to share — just promoted to Staff Eng, today is my 3-year Redwood anniversary, and we adopted a corgi this morning 😻🥰. Would love a small desk-drop celebration around 3pm. No pressure, just vibes.
Camila: WHAT!!! Huge congrats on all three!!! :tada: I can bring mini cupcakes and a tiny corgi plush for the desk.
Raj: Amazing news Noor, congrats!!! 🙌 Should we do a quick 10-min huddle at 3 so remote folks can pop in?
Noor: Love that. 10-min huddle sounds perfect — remote friends welcome.
Zoe: I vote snacks + silly corgi hats. Also can someone make a short slide with pictures of the pupper?
Theo: I will make the slide. Food poll: savory (mini quiches) vs sweet (assorted cookies) vs mixed? Vote with emoji.
Camila: :one: savory
Raj: :three: mixed
Zoe: :three: mixed
Noor: Mixed wins! Thanks y'all. Please label anything that needs refrigeration.
CalendarBot: Event created by Noor: "Noor - Triple Celebration" 2026-03-27 15:00-15:10 (Office + Zoom) — attendees: team, all-hands optional.
ConfettiBot: Automated confetti shower scheduled at 15:03 PST. :confetti_ball:
Camila: Also posting a tiny Google Form to collect well-wishes for a card — remote folks can add messages.
Raj: Sending a GIF: https://giphy.com/gifs/dog-corgi-happy-3o6Zt6ML6BklcajjsA
Zoe: I made a 3-slide deck: 1) quick congrats 2) corgi photos 3) Noor’s top 3 debug battle stories (for roast) 
Theo: Haha the roast slide is lethal. Noor, want me to print a banner or should we do a whiteboard?
Noor: Whiteboard banner please (less noisy). Also no roast too mean! 😂 Thank you all — feeling very cheesy and loved. See you at 3pm!
